admission.justification: Four registered cases pin the admitted forms and every refusal. Without the route a curator must either drop the proof or cite a neighbouring construct, so an invariant that a running parameterised case does establish is recorded unproven or proven by the wrong place.

applicability: A curator hand-off's proof for a JavaScript or TypeScript .test. or .spec. file at the code candidate, where no path::name resolves to the case the proof names.
conditions: The range equals exactly one case's extent: the outermost it or test call, from its first line to the line that closes it.
Every modifier is read by name on the case and on each enclosing describe: each, for, only, concurrent, sequential, skip, todo, skipIf, runIf, fails.
The case runs: no .skip, .todo, .skipIf, .runIf or .fails applies to it or to an enclosing suite.
No path::name reaches the case; a case a title reaches is refused as a definition and the refusal names the name.
exclusions: A call whose callee carries a member outside those modifiers (test.describe, test.step, test.setTimeout), and a call with a parse error: both are no case.
A file that is not a JavaScript or TypeScript .test. or .spec. file.
The inner it.each([...]) call of a parameterised case, which is no case of its own.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_memory_case_ranges.py (9 tests, 4 cited); 6 of them passed in the focused run of 2026-10-21; report role-reports/worker/6d23acbf-b211-5811-8ded-6aeaf57a721d/role-launch/260928-MIK-L186-worker-6d23acbf-b211-5811-8ded-6aeaf57a721d.md

statement: A test case that runs but that no name reaches is proved by the exact lines it occupies, and a case that does not run proves nothing and no range reaches it.
